record.question: What is 'dead time' in a GM counter?
options: The time it takes for the counter to be turned on.
The time it takes for the electronic components to process the signal.
The period immediately following a detection event during which the counter is insensitive to further radiation.
The lifespan of the gas in the GM tube.
record.explanation: Answer C: The period immediately following a detection event during which the counter is insensitive to further radiation.. GM-counter dead time is the post-event interval in which the detector cannot register another event. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/pml/periodic-table-elements; https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
